corpus.integrity_scope: existing loader verifies all frozen corpus bytes and groups, then filters train before authoring, chunking or mining; evaluation question files are never opened

pilot.selection: freeze deterministic topic-stratified family selection before authoring; export partition-specific train-only local packs
pilot.shortfall_policy: report shortfall and remain data_not_ready; never fill quotas with paraphrase duplicates or unsupported questions

draft_contract.evidence_rule: single required fact; multiple evidence entries are reviewed alternative support for that same fact, never implicit multi-hop
draft_contract.question_family_rule: one intent identifier groups translations and paraphrases; count unique intents separately from rows and corpus families
draft_contract.authoring_record: preserve author instructions and accepted model/reasoning settings; generation receipt hashes instructions, local author pack and final draft; recompilation is reproducible, generative inference is not

negative_mining.selection: existing BM25 rank order with stable chunk tie order, no dense or reranker score threshold
negative_mining.negative_definition: candidate full chunk does not support the specific requested fact; mere absence from positive annotations is insufficient
negative_mining.required_review: independent AI review of question, positive evidence and complete candidate chunk; record reason, reviewer and candidate text hash; human review remains pending

training_proposal.hypothesis: adapt E5 candidate retrieval because frozen M3 aggregate has 21 candidate-limited failures and 1 ranking-only failure
training_proposal.peft_policy: LoRA is a separate deferred experiment requiring a new versioned plan and dependency lock; do not sweep or silently switch

training_readiness.if_any_gate_fails: do_not_train; preserve validated data and explicit outstanding gate report

evaluation.bounded_comparison: one frozen base checkpoint versus one terminal checkpoint; no best-epoch selection or calibration sweep
evaluation.promotion_gate: calibration primary must increase by at least one question with no decrease in evidence recall at5; a pilot tie or failure keeps the original model
evaluation.main_dev: only once after data, code, terminal checkpoint and evaluation config are frozen; report all gains and regressions without retuning this run
evaluation.test: locked; existing explicit final evaluation gate unchanged
evaluation.service: no automatic adoption; Java security and browser regression gate remain separate
evaluation.ablation: data-size/negative-quality ablations remain roadmap work; not claimed by this single run

sources.use: contrastive pretraining and supervised fine-tuning with mined negatives; does not establish DocTrail GPU feasibility
query/passsage prefixes, masked mean pooling, normalization, 512 token limit, InfoNCE temperature
ordinary gradient accumulation does not increase the shared in-batch negative pool; GradCache is a distinct deferred option
low rank adaptation is an alternative requiring explicit supported target modules, not evidence of quality or measured local memory
